## Digital Marketing Practice

::: {style="font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.1;"}

### Website Features and Consumer Engagement

- Presents Beyond Meat’s brand positioning
- Displays products and product information
- Includes a frequently asked questions section
- Offers an email newsletter
- Supports consumer education and product consideration

**Takeaway:** Beyond Meat’s website helps consumers understand the brand, explore products, and remain engaged.

<small>Source: Beyond Meat official website [2]</small>

:::

---

## Marketing Practices and Consumer Adoption

::: {style="font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.1;"}

- The case compares Beyond Meat with Silk
- Silk placed plant-based milk beside traditional milk
- Familiar placement made the product easier to find and recognize
- Similar placement could help Beyond Meat reach traditional meat consumers
- Familiar meal occasions may reduce uncertainty

**Takeaway:** Familiar packaging, placement, and meal occasions can make behavior change easier for first-time buyers.

<small>Source: Beyond Meat case, p. 14 [1]</small>

:::

---

## Competitive Analysis

::: {style="font-size: 0.55em; line-height: 1.1;"}

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="50%"}

### Market Size

**Historical case data**

- U.S. meat industry revenue in 2013: **$219 billion**
- U.S. meat industry net profits in 2013: **$19 billion**
- Traditional meat industry growth: **approximately 4%**
- Meat-alternative market in 2012: **$553 million**
- Meat-alternative market growth: **8%**

:::

::: {.column width="50%"}

### Competitor Categories

**Direct competitors**

- LikeMeat
- Impossible Foods
- MorningStar Farms

**Traditional and cross-category competitors**

- Tyson Foods
- Pilgrim’s Pride
- Sanderson Farms
- Perdue Farms

:::

::::

**Takeaway:** Beyond Meat entered a much larger traditional meat industry, while faster growth in meat alternatives created an opportunity for expansion.

<small>Source: Beyond Meat case, pp. 13–14 [1]</small>

:::

---

## Competitive Analysis

::: {style="font-size: 0.55em; line-height: 1.1;"}

### Direct Competitor Comparison

| Competitor | Category | Competitive relevance |
|---|---|---|
| LikeMeat | Plant-based meat | Direct competitor identified in the case |
| Impossible Foods | Plant-based meat | Competes for meat-alternative consumers |
| MorningStar Farms | Meat alternatives | Established plant-based competitor |
| Beyond Meat | Plant-based meat | Focal company competing across the category |

- Competitors target similar consumer needs
- Health, environment, taste, and convenience shape competition
- Tyson also entered the plant-based market
- Beyond Meat must clearly differentiate its positioning

**Takeaway:** Beyond Meat must explain why consumers should choose its products over other plant-based brands and traditional meat.

<small>Source: Beyond Meat case, pp. 13–14 [1]</small>

:::

## SWOT Analysis

::: {style="font-size: 0.55em; line-height: 1.0;"}

<tr>

<strong>STRENGTHS</strong>

<ul>

<td style="width:50%; height:190px; vertical-align:top; background:#2F5D45; color:#123D24; padding:14px; border-radius:12px;">

<li>Uncertainty about changing eating habits</li>
<li>Taste and texture concerns</li>
</ul>

</td>

</tr>

<tr>

<td style="width:50%; height:190px; vertical-align:top; background:#2F5D45; color:#123D24; padding:14px; border-radius:12px;">

<strong>OPPORTUNITIES</strong>

<ul>
<li>Health-conscious consumers</li>
<li>Flexitarians and meat reducers</li>
<li>Mainstream consumer acceptance</li>
</ul>

</td>

<td style="width:50%; height:190px; vertical-align:top; background:#2F5D45; color:#123D24; padding:14px; border-radius:12px;">

<strong>THREATS</strong>

<ul>

<li>Tyson’s entry into plant-based products</li>

</ul>

</td>

</tr>

</table>

<p style="color:#123D24; font-size:0.9em;">
<strong>Takeaway:</strong> Beyond Meat can use health positioning and consumer education to build mainstream acceptance, but it must overcome competition and resistance to behavior change.
</p>

<small style="color:#123D24;">Source: Beyond Meat case, pp. 13–14 [1]</small>
